subject: Mutual plan: POC onramp — API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@vitalhealth.com>, CloudBridge Engineering <eng@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan: POC onramp — API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Hi Samantha / CloudBridge team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — excited to get the VitalHealth evaluation into a production-like environment. I put together the initial mutual plan (attached) that covers the POC onboarding items we agreed: org & tenant setup, API keys and key lifecycle, IP allowlist, and VPC peering. High-level ask: confirm owners for each bullet below and whether the timelines work.

Quick summary / asks:
- Org setup: VitalHealth creates the org/tenant and invites Redwood SRE (redwood-svc@redwood.ai) as a service user with Owner-level access for the trial tenant. Please tell us the org ID when ready.
- API keys: We will generate an ephemeral API key pair for the POC and share rotation guidance. We need a contact who can receive the initial secret over your secure channel.
- IP allowlist: provide the public IP ranges you want to allow to the POC endpoints (we will also provide our egress ranges for peering).
- VPC peering: CloudBridge — can you confirm acceptance of our peering template and provide target VPC CIDR and preferred peering window? We included a peering template in the attachments.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Fri Apr 9: org ID + contact for API keys
- Mon Apr 12–Thu Apr 15: IP allowlist & peering config + test peering
- Tue Apr 20: internal smoke tests and demo cutover window

Attachments: MAP_VitalHealth_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), vpc_peering_template.txt
HubSpot: HS-78912 — I’ll update the MAP there as we lock owners.

Can you confirm owners and the org ID by end of day Friday? If you’d rather a brief sync, I can set 20 minutes tomorrow.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@vitalhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudBridge Engineering <eng@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan: POC onramp — API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear plan. Quick responses inline: 

- Org setup: I’ll create the trial org today and invite redwood-svc@redwood.ai. I’ll send the org ID in a follow-up.
- API keys: We prefer to receive initial secrets through our Vault team (vault+incoming@vitalhealth.com). Will that work?
- IP allowlist: Our networking team needs Redwood’s egress ranges and a recommended ephemeral port list for the test window.
- VPC peering: CloudBridge will review your template; they requested our VPC CIDR (10.140.0.0/16) and asked if we can target a peering window on Mon Apr 12 between 02:00–05:00 UTC.

Two small asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether you need any peering-level route propagation change on our side (we prefer limited route exchange, only specific subnets).
2) We have a standard security questionnaire to slot later in the week — I’ll send it as a separate email.

We can hit Fri Apr 9 for org ID and contact. I’ll loop in our networking lead (cc’d CloudBridge) for schedule confirmation.

—Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director, Platform Ops | VitalHealth
samantha@vitalhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@vitalhealth.com>, CloudBridge Engineering <eng@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Mutual plan: POC onramp — API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Neha / Jonas — forwarding Samantha’s reply and calling out ownership asks so we can commit the dates. Short internal notes below — please reply with firm owners and any blockers.

Quoted: 
> - Org setup: I’ll create the trial org today and invite redwood-svc@redwood.ai. I’ll send the org ID in a follow-up.
> - API keys: We prefer to receive initial secrets through our Vault team (vault+incoming@vitalhealth.com). Will that work?
> - IP allowlist: Our networking team needs Redwood’s egress ranges and a recommended ephemeral port list for the test window.
> - VPC peering: CloudBridge will review your template; they requested our VPC CIDR (10.140.0.0/16) and asked if we can target a peering window on Mon Apr 12 between 02:00–05:00 UTC.

Internal asks / proposal: 
- Neha: can you own the API key exchange + coordinate secure delivery to their Vault team? If yes, we’ll prepare the ephemeral key and the rotation plan by EOD Apr 9.
- Jonas: can you own the VPC peering orchestration with CloudBridge (validate template + run the peering during the proposed window)? Jonas, please advise whether the 02:00–05:00 UTC slot works for Redwood infra and whether we should request a different window.
- Networking: I’m attaching our egress ranges in the MAP; we will propose only the specific subnets we need to exchange (no broad route propagation unless you request).

If we can commit owners today, I’ll send a consolidated reply to Samantha with firm dates and the POC checklist attachment.

Thanks — Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@vitalhealth.com>, CloudBridge Engineering <eng@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan: POC onramp — API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering — owners & dates

Hi Samantha / CloudBridge — quick update and confirmed owners so you have a single source of truth.

Committed owners and dates: 
- Org ID: VitalHealth to provide org ID by EOD Fri Apr 9 (Samantha).
- API keys: Redwood will provision an ephemeral API key for the POC and deliver to your Vault team. Owner: Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwood.ai). Delivery ETA: Apr 9 (sent via secure delivery to vault+incoming@vitalhealth.com).
- IP allowlist: Redwood egress ranges included in the MAP attachment; VitalHealth to confirm allowed CIDRs. Owner: Samantha (your networking lead). ETA: Apr 12.
- VPC peering: Jonas Weber will run the peering with CloudBridge. Owner: Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@redwood.ai). Proposed peering window: Mon Apr 12 02:00–05:00 UTC. Jonas — please confirm if Redwood is good for that window or suggest an alternate.

Next steps:
1) Samantha — please send the org ID and confirm the Vault contact so Neha can hand off the key securely.
2) Jonas — if the peering window works, we’ll schedule the small maintenance window and send test vectors afterwards.
3) I attached the POC-Checklist.pdf that lists tests we’ll run post-peering; the final demo target remains Tue Apr 20.

If anything changes, quick replies here are fine. Otherwise I’ll update HubSpot (HS-78912) with the committed MAP items.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: POC-Checklist.pdf (pdf)
